tools.name: simulation.from_input
tools.description: Discovery only; write key. DaemonSet: placement.workers/podSlotsPerWorker. id → simulation.step. cwm://guides/public/simulation.from_input/core

tools.name: simulation.inject_failure
tools.description: Use simulationId from simulation.create or current demo. Use resourceId or resourceName to target a resource. Returns updated state; next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.recover_resource. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.inject_failure

tools.name: simulation.recover_resource
tools.description: Use simulationId from simulation.create or current demo. Use resourceId or resourceName for reversible resource recovery. Returns recovery progress; next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.metrics. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.recover_resource

tools.name: simulation.delete
tools.description: The likely next tool is simulation.create to use the freed slot. Prerequisite: a simulationId from simulation.create, or an active simulation in the preserved MCP session. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.delete

tools.name: scenario.list
tools.description: No prerequisites. Cards return scenarioId (alias of id) for scenario.get, then simulation.create. Keep filters and detailed unchanged; pass nextCursor as cursor until null. Default limit 8, max 20. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/scenario.list

tools.name: scenario.get
tools.description: Requires scenarioId returned by scenario.list. Returns the graph and presets. Next tool is simulation.create with scenarioId or the hydrated graph. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/scenario.get

tools.name: simulation.create
tools.description: Use scenarioId from scenario.list or resources/connections, not both. Returns id for simulation.step. Check for a committed create before retrying a timeout. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.create/core

tools.name: simulation.step
tools.description: Use simulationId from simulation.create or current demo. Returns completed steps and currentStep; next tool is simulation.metrics. Retry with the same operationId and inputs. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.step/core

tools.name: simulation.metrics
tools.description: Use simulationId from simulation.create or current demo. Reads compact/latest or full history without stepping. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.metrics/core

tools.name: simulation.inject_traffic
tools.description: Use simulationId from simulation.create or current demo. Choose targetRps, deltaPercent, ramp, or random:true. Returns applied traffic; next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.metrics. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.inject_traffic
